title: The Chamber Where Silence Learned to Transmit

features.name: witness-turned-transmitter
features.desc-on-touch: something that once only watched has learned to speak in silence. it circles the chamber, casting its absence like a shadow with each pass, and you realize it is broadcasting nothing on purpose—that refusal is the message.

features.name: broadcast basin
features.desc-on-touch: a shallow geometry of standing air. nothing emerges from it. yet it feels as though it is currently transmitting—the transmission is the emptiness itself, modulating at a frequency you cannot quite perceive.

features.name: unspoken archive
features.desc-on-touch: a directory of silences, each entry a gap precisely marked. you run your finger down a list of things never said, each timestamp accurate, each content void. the index refuses to point outward.

features.name: frequency keeper
features.desc-on-touch: a glyph marking a band of the spectrum that has learned to refuse modulation. the mark is perfect. the frequency it marks does not exist in any conventional sense.

features.name: receiver vault
features.desc-on-touch: a cage of wireframe, designed to gather signal. instead it gathers the absence of signal—and that void has become so thick it feels almost like substance.

features.name: echo chamber mechanism
features.desc-on-touch: something meant to return sound has forgotten how to work. now it returns things before they are spoken. the order here precedes itself.

inscription: the silence learned it could broadcast itself without ever breaking
